server_port.description: TCP port for the GridFTP control connection (standard GridFTP port is 2811)

listen_address.description: IP address the GridFTP service listens on (e.g., '10.0.0.5' or '::' for IPv6)

start.description: First port in data connection range

end.description: Last port in data connection range

data_port_range.description: Range of TCP ports used for passive-mode data transfers (must be open in firewall)

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed

path.description: Path to CA certificate file or directory (e.g., '/etc/grid-security/certificates')

trusted_cas.description: List of trusted certificate authorities for GSI authentication

match_type.description: Match criterion: DN (Distinguished Name), FQAN (Fully Qualified Attribute Name), or 'all'

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match DN or FQAN

access_rules.description: Ordered list of allow/deny rules for client access control

proxy_storage_path.description: Directory path for storing delegated GSI proxies (requires write access)

transfer_timeout.description: Maximum idle time (seconds) before an in-progress transfer is aborted

connection_idle_timeout.description: Seconds before an idle control connection is closed

max_transfer_rate.description: Maximum transfer rate in bytes/second per client (0 = unlimited)

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS for control and data connections (GSI+TLS hybrid mode)

tls_cipher_list.description: Colon-separated list of allowed TLS cipher suites

tls_client_auth_required.description: Require client certificates for TLS connections (if TLS enabled)

log_file.description: Path to log file or 'syslog' to use the system logger

log_level.description: Verbosity level of logging (debug is most verbose)

dirlist_cache.description: Enable caching of directory listings for improved performance

dirlist_cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live (seconds) for cached directory listings (ignored if dirlist_cache = off)

enable_http_proxy.description: Enable HTTP CONNECT proxy support (e.g., for web-based clients)

http_proxy_host.description: Hostname of HTTP proxy server (only used if HTTP proxy enabled)

http_proxy_port.description: Port of HTTP proxy server (only used if HTTP proxy enabled)
